sottotitolo: Who has confirmed, who has said no and who has not answered yet. A confirmation changes nothing about the current year.
nessunAnno: Pick the year with open enrolment from the selector above to see the confirmations.
annoNonAperto: Enrolment for this year is not open: confirmations are collected once it is.
annoAttivo: This is the current year. Pick the year with open enrolment from the selector above.
erroreRete: I cannot connect. Check the connection and try again.
errorePermesso: You do not have permission to do this.
erroreGenerico: The operation could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
vuoto: There is no child to confirm in this list.
nessunaPrimaria: Next year does not have primary school classes yet.
esitoRiaperta: Next-year enrolment reopened: it had been closed.
esitoSezioneIgnorata: The chosen class was not applied: the child already has one for next year.
esitoPostiOltre: The authorised places are exceeded: the confirmation is recorded all the same.
esitoRettaPersonalizzata: This year’s personalised fee does not carry over: next year the price list applies.
avvisoPosti: Check the places, group “{fascia}”: enrolled {iscritti}, authorised places {posti}. It is a warning, not a block.
annullareNota: To undo a confirmation use “Withdraw the confirmation” on the child’s row (done by administration and the secretary’s office). Afterwards you can mark “Not renewing” or confirm again.
vuotoNuove: There are no new enrolments in this list.
nuoveNota: These are the children coming from outside and those coming back after leaving: tick the forms as the family hands them in.
moduliNessuno: No form is required for this enrolment.
firmatoInAppNota: This is only information: ticking stays with the office.
avvisoSenzaFascia: {n, plural, one {# child is in a class without a group: the places per group do not count them. Choose the group of the classes in the year settings, Classes tab.} other {# children are in classes without a group: the places per group do not count them. Choose the group of the classes in the year settings, Classes tab.}}
esitoQuotaSenzaListino: The fee was not created because the year price list has none for this class: set it in the year settings, then press “Generate the fee”.
esitoQuotaPiuVoci: This child has more than one fee item: check the accounts.
ritiraDomanda: Withdraw the confirmation of {nome}? Next year’s enrolment is closed and, if the fee has not been paid, the fee is removed. Afterwards you can mark “Not renewing” or confirm again.
esitoRitirataQuotaPagata: The fee has already been paid: refunds or reversals are handled in accounting.
esitoRitirataQuotaErrore: The confirmation is withdrawn, but the fee could not be removed: check it in accounting.
